newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen in oil deal with Canada's Calvalley.
newsitem.headline: Yemen in oil deal with Canada's Calvalley.

text.p: Yemen has signed two oil exploration memoranda of understanding with Calgary-based Calvalley Petroleum Inc, Oil Ministry undersecretary Saleh Ba-Rabaa said.
He told Reuters one MOU is for oil exploration in sector nine between Shabwa and Hadramout provinces and the other is for exploration in sector 39 in Mahra province.
He did not give other details not the cost of projects. The memoranda still have to be approved by the government to become official agreements.
Yemen is one of the poorest countries in the Arab world and is dependent on its oilfields, which produce about 365,000 barrels per day.
